name: signup-01
title: Signup 01
description: A guest check on the desk: a paper clip, dashed tear lines top and bottom, and a member number in the corner. Name, email, password twice and a Google button, with live messages in the fields. Made for the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Signup 01" block into your components directory under blocks/signup-01/.
Import it: import Signup01Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/signup-01/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
